channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Byron Donalds raises $90 million for Governor's race as opponents struggle with fundraising
item.description: U.S. Rep. Byron Donalds consolidated virtually all major Republican endorsements and continues to dominate fundraising in the gubernatorial primary, raising nearly $2 million in one week alone.

item.title: Martin County School Board challenges judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook post
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against Administrative Law Judge Jodi-Ann Vanessa Livingstone's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a social studies teacher at Spectrum Academy since 2009 who was suspended last year for Facebook comments about conservative acti

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year as inflation hits holiday staples
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description:
A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. The crash happened around 2 a.m. near State Road 710, also known as Beeline Highway, and Southwest Silver Fox Lane.

item.title: Martin County woman dies in Hobe Sound home fire, community raises funds for fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed many belongings.

item.title: Port St. Lucie City Council to vote on giving 7 acres to FDOT for Midway Road Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at Midway Road and Florida's Turnpike. Final approval is scheduled for an upcoming meeting.

item.title: Fort Pierce Peacock House Art Foundation offers tours, art classes in historic Crain Estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce preserves the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain in the historic Crain Estate. The foundation offers guided tours and an artist-in-residency program attracting artists from around the world.

item.title: Stuart breast cancer patient speaks out after Anthem Blue Cross denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her insurance deny coverage for breast reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before it was scheduled. The denial involved a surgical mesh called GalaFlex that Anthem considers investigational.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue 2 boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit responded to reports of a small motorized boat taking on water and becoming submerged on July 1. Both occupants were wearing life jackets and were rescued without injury.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4% this year as ground beef and strawberry prices climb
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago. Ground beef is up 5.5%, buns are up 7.7%, and strawberries are up 12.4% after a Florida frost.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes today for $3 million renovation, capacity to nearly double
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock closed July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. The year-long project will nearly double the dock's capacity, expanding from 18 to 44 slips for both motorized and non-motorized vessels. The renovation is funded by a state grant

item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams withdrew from her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday due to a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina survives Cape Verde 3-2 in World Cup thriller
item.description: Defending World Cup champion Argentina beat Cape Verde 3-2 on Friday in South Florida, advancing to the Round of 16 after the tiny island nation challenged them until the final minutes of extra time.

item.title: Saint Andrew's Scots football targets state title after 10-2 season and district championship
item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football team is preparing for the 2026 fall season with state title aspirations after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district championship. item.title: St. Lucie Mets Snap Nine-Game Skid With Late Comeback Win Over Tarpons
item.description:
The St. Lucie Mets ended their nine-game losing streak Sunday afternoon with a late offensive surge, rallying past the Tampa Tarpons for a 10-5 win at Clover Park.

item.title: Florida students reach milestone with 60% testing at grade level in reading and math
item.description: For the first time in state history, 60% of Florida students tested at or above grade level in both reading and math on annual assessments, representing a significant increase from three years ago.

item.title: FEMA awards $7.2 million to four Florida communities for Hurricane Ian recovery projects
item.description: FloridaCommerce announced distribution of federal hazard mitigation funds to Charlotte County, Port of the Islands, Seminole County, and Palatka for infrastructure projects related to the 2022 hurricane.

item.title: United States faces Belgium in World Cup Round of 16 with Florida fans watching
item.description: The U.S. men's national team plays Belgium Monday night at Lumen Field in Seattle after earning the program's first knockout stage victory since 2002 against Bosnia and Herzegovina.

item.title: European World Cup visitors face financial pressures from aging populations and high tax rates
item.description: European fans traveling through the United States for the World Cup benefit from more vacation time than Americans, but face rising retirement ages and tax burdens at home as populations age.

item.title: Americans mark 250th anniversary with tempered enthusiasm about democracy's state
item.description: In interviews across the country ahead of the Fourth of July, Americans expressed resilience and local focus rather than the brash confidence historically associated with the nation's image.

item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination while preserving the historic Crain Estate.
